svg.title: A list of floats and a NumPy array
svg.desc: Two parts. Tag 1: a Python list is a block of slots; each slot holds a reference, drawn as an arrow, to a separate float object (0.0, 1.0, 2.0) somewhere else on the heap. Tag 2: a NumPy array of float64 is one block in which the numbers 0.0, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 sit side by side, with no separate objects.
